apply.description: Temporary values to apply before reading (not persisted)

cursors.description: Optional pagination cursors keyed by entries in `read`. Pass `nextOffset` from a previous truncated response to continue paging through that range. Formula entries (those starting with `=`) ignore cursors.

read.description: Cell references, ranges, or formulas to read. Examples: "A1", "B1:B10", "Sheet1!C5", "=XLOOKUP(\"Revenue\", A1:A10, B1:B10)", "=AVERAGE(C1:C10)"

name: readCalculatedValues
